spans.s:
Komaṭi
or pedakomaTi Reddi king of Koṇḍavīḍu. in Āndhra; son of Māca an. father of Vemabhūpāla (a. of C. Śṛṅgāradīpikā on Amaruśataka etc. an. patron of Vāmana Bhaṭṭa Bāṇa.

Komaṭiyajvan
of Vatsagotra; son of Varadāgnicit an. father of Vāmana Bhaṭṭa Bāṇa (a. of Vemabhūpālacarita, Śabdaratnākara etc.).
See

Komalakośasaṅgraha
compiled from several lexicons. by Tīrthasvāmin.

Komalavallīprapatti
on Komalavallī, a form of goddess Lakṣmī, worshipped a. Kumbhakonam. by Veṅkaṭeśa, son of Prativādibhayaṅkara of Śrīvatsagotra.

Komalavallīstava
by Maheśvarānanda. Q. in his Mahārthamañjarī

Komalavallīstava
ms. in a private collection in Nagappattanam noticed in Adyar Library Bulletin VI. p. 205.

Komalā
name of C. by Viśvanāthatīrtha (latter half of 16th Cent. A. D.) on Śaśadhara's Nyāyasiddhāntadīpa. [Page095-a.
See History of Navyanyāya in Mithilā p. 185.

Komalādaṇḍaka
stotra on goddess Komalavallī a. Kumbhakonam. by Veṅkaṭeśa or Veṅkaṭārya (Pāttrārya), son of Kumāra Tātadeśika.

.
Pt.. Deśikasampradāyavivardhinīsabhā work no. 17. in Grantha script. Kumbhakonam, 1911. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1360.
